description: Significant Wastewater Treatment Plants is a dataset listed in State of Maryland open data portal (opendata.maryland.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Maryland. The Maryland Department of the Environment (MDE) identifies and maintains locations of significant wastewater treatment plants throughout Maryland. Coverage: Maryland. Its tags are md imap, mde, md, maryland department of the environment, maryland. The table has 17 columns. The portal shows 2025-07-21 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-opendata-maryland-gov-portal.
